pdf.history_heading: History of updates applied to the catalogue

faq.a: RiskHub monitors the regulatory frameworks you already use and keeps your catalogue up to date automatically. It only notifies you when it needs your confirmation.

faq.q: What do I need to configure?
faq.a: Nothing beyond turning on the switch. The monitored frameworks are derived automatically from what you use in RiskHub.
No. It detects and proposes changes; it does not certify or replace your consultant or auditor.

faq.q: What happens if I disable it?
faq.a: You stop receiving notifications and your copies remain untouched. You can re-enable it whenever you want without losing your configuration.

faq.q: Does it process personal data from my organization?
faq.a: No. It only analyzes public regulatory documents using AI.
